address: 66-70 South Jiangbin West Avenue, Cangshan, Fuzhou, China Mainland
bio: For over 10 years, this restaurant has been serving live seafood alongside a range of Fuzhou dishes. Only private rooms are available and there is no paper menu – diners are asked to pick their own seafood from the live fish tank. What sets it apart from the competition is its obsession with rare seafood and exotic ingredients. Try sautéed clam worms with flowering chives that taste meaty and smoky, or buttery skate liver in lotus leaf buns....
